__paket: P12 — der eigene Bereich „Dein Zugang“: Rolle, Runden, geöffnete Einladung, Abmelden (2026-09-10).
Du kannst auf diesem Server eigene Runde: On this server you can create your own groups and invite others to them.
Du spielst in Runden, zu denen dich eine: You play in groups a game master invites you to. On this server, only whoever set it up can create groups.
Innerhalb einer Runde hat jeder zusätzli: Within a group everyone also has their own role. The game master sees the forge and all the rules there; as a player you see your characters, the table, the chronicle and everything released to you.
Du bist noch in keiner Runde. Sobald dic: You are not in a group yet. As soon as a game master invites you, it appears here.
Diese Einladung gehört zu einer Runde, i: This invitation belongs to a group you are not in yet. Joining creates its own access for that group — it is not merged with “{name}”.
Das ist Absicht: In jeder Runde trittst: That is deliberate: in every group you appear under the name you give there. So sign out first — the invitation stays open and you can accept it afterwards.
Abmelden und Einladung annehmen: Sign out and accept the invitation
Ohne beides kommst du nach dem Abmelden: Without either of these, after signing out you can only get back with a new pairing code from your game master. Best to set one of them up now.
Takes you back to the sign-in page. There you can sign in again, connect a new device, or join a group.
Abmelden und zur Anmeldeseite: Sign out and go to the sign-in page
